changelog: Objective battles are cleaner and clearer: Hold and Survive now brief both ways to win (complete the objective OR raze the enemy base), Survive throws an extra enemy force at you so it truly is a last stand, and objective levels no longer pop a needless enemy-type intro. The top bar tidies up too — the boss name now rides in an ornate toast pill, and the Bases counter is hidden whenever there's no base to pursue (boss fights and objectives like escape or hold-the-center). In the Army tab, tapping a unit now centers the camera and flashes a gold ring so it's easy to spot.
